about: Live copy and links that the page-builder sections deliberately do not reproduce word for word, each with its reason. scripts/migrate/verify-content.mjs fails on any miss that is not listed here. `copy` entries match page-content copy strings (by page, tag and/or text); `links` entries match page-content links (anchor text + target). `changes` and `structural` document the other deliberate differences; they are not used for matching. Captured from the live site on 2026-10-13.

copy.text: A whole house surge protector installs at your electrical panel and protects every circuit in your home from voltage spikes.
